reason: If a creator I actually follow is using it on camera, I'd probably grab the 3-pack plan with their code, since $49.99 plus $12.99 shipping for the bottle alone feels like a rip-off next to it. I'd set a reminder to check whether I want the renewal in six months.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and I'm not sure a filter in a bottle is worth it when I mostly just forget my bottle at home anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If cancelling took more than one click or the first filters tasted off, I'd cancel and not reorder.
